scope: Read-only follow-on interface audit, not a changed contract or runtime acceptance

findings.finding: Edge furniture currently returns success after room origin and rotation checks; undirected edge occupancy/overlap is absent. Starter materialization must not bypass this by treating a plan edge as validated live topology.

Current edge reassignment only requires same building, not actual endpoint adjacency. Future encoding must define canonical undirected key separately from explicit Furniture.room ownership; mask contribution remains only to that declared owner.
Existing fixture mutator is not an atomic production topology edit and provides no occupied-edge or last-exit safeguards.
The compact plan records endpoint tiles and endpoint room ordinals. Runtime origin/rotation encoding remains a subsequent reviewed consumer contract; no extra exterior-door furniture may be invented.

next_contract_scope: Canonical edge encoding for all four rotations and undirected duplicate detection
Same-building endpoint room ownership and reassignment semantics
Atomic topology publication with map revision and occupied/last-exit protection
Real wall opening/support/contact geometry and body-envelope qualification
